name: grantmakersio
description: Summary profiles for all US-based foundations who have filed electronic IRS Form 990-PF

scripts.dev: webpack --mode development --watch & bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload --config _config.yml,_config_development.yml
scripts.parallels: webpack --mode development --watch & bundle exec jekyll serve --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.stage: webpack --mode production && JEKYLL_ENV=staging bundle exec jekyll build --config=_config.yml,_config_staging.yml
scripts.build: webpack --mode production && bundle exec jekyll build

author: Chad Kruse
